text:
nina: Heads-up — opened a PR for the SDK migration (auth snippet) from v0.9 -> v1.0. Linkcheck in the docs preview is failing. Not high priority but would like this merged before the release window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/582

docs-bot: docs-preview: automated preview ran and failed linkcheck for /sdk/auth.md (404)
```
LinkCheckError: 404 Not Found: /api/auth/v1 referenced from /sdk/auth.md:42
```

sam: I can take this. Is it just the one broken link or other changes?

nina: Mostly the one relative link. Also renamed a param in the snippet (client_id -> clientKey). Small patch.

leo: I'm on reviewer rotation but I'll be in a meeting until ~3pm PT. If Sam starts I can finish the review later.

ashley: heads-up — Thurs rotation has a gap so if this slips, ping docs-rotation channel to reassign.

sam: taking it now. Plan: fix link to /api/auth/v2 (new route), update snippet param, run linkcheck locally, push. ETA ~30m.

sam: pushed fix to branch: changed /api/auth/v1 -> /api/auth/v2 and updated snippet param name. @nina PTAL.

deploy-bot: CI started for PR #582 — running linters and preview build.

rachel: tiny nit — can we add a short migration note under release-notes/v1.0 so users know the path changed?

nina: good call, added a 1-line note under release-notes/v1.0.

sam: running local linkcheck...
```
$ yarn docs:linkcheck
✔ no broken links found
```

docs-bot: docs-preview: Linkcheck OK. Preview URL: https://redwood-docs-preview/pr-582

leo: LGTM — one formatting nit in the snippet (aligned indent).

sam: fixed formatting nit, pushed.

leo: approving now :thumbsup: — leaving one comment about wording but not blocking.

nina: thanks everyone. I'll merge once CI is green.

deploy-bot: merge-queue: PR #582 merged to main (no conflicts).

nina: merged and released to staging. Thanks team :tada:
